visual.general_description: Five-panel clinical figure for Patient 1: fundus photographs, fluorescein angiography, OCT, kinetic perimetry and flash ERG.
visual.detailed_description: Five lettered panels a to e arranged in rows: paired fundus photographs, paired angiograms, paired OCT scans, two visual field charts and ERG tracings. Printed labels include OD, OS and scale bars; white arrows appear on the OCT scan and a black arrow on the ERG.

panels.general_description: Two color fundus photographs labeled OD and OS.
panels.detailed_description: Panel a shows two wide-field color fundus photographs side by side with the printed labels OD above the left image and OS above the right image. Both show an orange-red retina with the optic disc and retinal vessels visible and greenish tones toward the edges. The right image has a darker reddish area in its upper right portion. No arrows or other annotations are visible in panel a.

imaging_modalities.visual_cue: Color fundus field with optic disc and vessels, labels OD and OS

imaging_submodalities.visual_cue: Circular wide-field color retinal image with optic disc and vessels

body_parts.visual_cue: Retina and optic disc visible in both images

pixel_observations: Left image labeled OD and right image labeled OS.
Optic disc and vessels visible in both images.
Darker reddish area in the upper right of the OS image.

caption_claims.value: Caption lists fundus photographs as panel a for Patient 1.

clinical_significance.statement: The case text calls the fundoscopy results unremarkable.

limitations: The darker area in the OS image is not interpreted.

panels.general_description: Two grayscale angiography images of the retinal vessels.
panels.detailed_description: Panel b shows two grayscale fluorescein angiography images side by side. Each shows a bright optic disc and branching retinal vessels filled with dye against a dark background. The left image shows a speckled bright pattern toward its periphery and the right image appears slightly hazier. No eye labels or arrows are printed within panel b.

imaging_modalities.visual_cue: Grayscale angiographic retinal images with bright vessels

pixel_observations: Bright optic disc and branching vessels in both images.
Speckled bright pattern toward the periphery of the left image.
No eye labels or arrows printed in panel b.

caption_claims.value: Caption lists fluorescein fundus angiography as panel b.

clinical_significance.statement: The case text reports dye leakage from the retinal vessels suggesting diffuse phlebitis.

evidence.quote: fluorescein fundus angiography (FA) revealed dye leakage from the retinal vessels, suggesting diffuse phlebitis (Fig. 1b)

limitations: Leakage cannot be judged from pixels; it is a text claim.
Eye assignment of the two images is not labeled in panel b.

panels.general_description: Two OCT cross-sections with a white arrow on the right image.
panels.detailed_description: Panel c shows two horizontal OCT cross-sectional scans side by side. Both show layered retina over a bright line of the outer retina with the optic nerve head near the inner edge of each scan. A white arrow below the bright outer line in the right scan points upward to a small focal bright spot. The left scan shows no arrow.
pixel_observations: Two scans side by side.
White arrow in the right scan below the bright outer line.
No printed eye labels in panel c.

caption_claims.value: Caption states disruption of the ellipsoid zone in both eyes and a nodule at the RPE line in the left eye, indicated by the white arrow in c.

evidence.quote: The OCT images reveal disruption of the ellipsoid zone (EZ) in both eyes (OU), along with a hyper-refractive nodule appearing at the retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) line in the left eye (OS) (indicated by the white arrow in c)

clinical_significance.statement: The authors describe EZ disruption and an RPE-line nodule on OCT.

evidence.quote: OCT revealed a disrupted EZ and hyper-reflective nodules in the RPE line OS (indicated by white arrow in Fig. 1c)

limitations: EZ disruption and the nodule are caption and text claims; they were not independently judged from pixels.
Which scan is which eye is not labeled in the panel.

panels.general_description: Two kinetic visual field charts labeled OS and OD.
panels.detailed_description: Panel d shows two circular polar visual field charts with concentric degree rings and radial lines. The left chart is labeled OS and the right chart is labeled OD. Plotted isopter contours and handwritten notes appear on each chart. Dense black marks fill a small area near the center of the left chart and a larger cross-hatched black area near the center of the right chart. A small grid table appears at the lower right of each chart.

body_parts.visual_cue: Visual field charts labeled OS and OD

pixel_observations: Left chart labeled OS and right chart labeled OD.
Black filled area near the center of each chart, larger on the OD chart.
Handwritten notes and a small table at the lower right of each chart.

caption_claims.value: Caption lists Goldmann kinetic perimetry as panel d.

clinical_significance.statement: The case text reports a significant scotoma OD on this panel.

evidence.quote: he exhibited a significant scotoma OD (Fig. 1d)

limitations: Handwritten notes and the small tables are too small to read.

panels.general_description: Flash ERG tracings labeled OD and OS with a black arrow.
panels.detailed_description: Panel e shows two electroretinography tracings stacked vertically on a shared axis frame, labeled OD above and OS below. Each trace starts near its baseline at a vertical dotted line, dips downward to a trough and then rises gradually. A black arrow points to the rising limb of the upper trace. A vertical scale bar is labeled 100 µV/div and a horizontal bar is labeled 10 ms/div.

limitations: No numeric amplitude or latency values are printed; none were read from the traces.

body_parts.visual_cue: ERG tracings labeled OD and OS

pixel_observations: Upper trace labeled OD and lower trace labeled OS.
Black arrow near the rising portion of the upper trace.
Scale bars read 100 µV/div and 10 ms/div.

caption_claims.value: Caption states oscillatory potentials are extinguished in the flash ERG, marked by the black arrow in e.

evidence.quote: Oscillatory potentials are extinguished in the flash ERG (marked by the black arrow in e)

clinical_significance.statement: The authors report extinguished oscillatory potentials on flash ERG.

evidence.quote: Oscillatory potentials are extinguished in the flash ERG (marked by the black arrow in e)

limitations: Oscillatory potentials were not independently judged; no numeric amplitudes were read.

visual.general_description: Four-panel figure for Patient 2: fundus photographs, fluorescein angiography and OCT at the initial visit and at follow-up.
visual.detailed_description: Four lettered panels a to d arranged in rows: paired color fundus photographs with OD and OS labels, paired angiograms, and two rows of paired OCT scans. White arrows labeled 1 and 2 mark single locations.

panels.general_description: Two color fundus photographs labeled OD and OS with a white arrow marked 1.
panels.detailed_description: Panel a shows two circular color fundus photographs labeled OD on the left and OS on the right. Each shows an orange retina with the optic disc and vessels. A white arrow labeled 1 points left toward a region at the upper right of the OS image. A small notch appears at the upper right edge of each circular field.

imaging_submodalities.visual_cue: Color retinal fundus images with optic disc

pixel_observations: Left image labeled OD and right image labeled OS.
White arrow labeled 1 in the OS image.

caption_claims.value: Caption lists fundus photographs as panel a for Patient 2.

clinical_significance.statement: The case text reports faint white dots in the upper area of the left macula at arrow 1.

evidence.quote: faint white dots in the left macula’s upper area (Fig. 2a, arrow 1)

limitations: The faint white dots are not independently identified from pixels.

panels.detailed_description: Panel b shows two grayscale fluorescein angiography images side by side with branching retinal vessels and a bright optic disc. The left image has a bright speckled region with scattered dark and bright spots along its left edge. The right image shows slightly bright vessels and a hazy bright zone toward its right side. No labels or arrows are printed within panel b.
pixel_observations: Bright speckled region along the left edge of the left image.
Hazy bright zone toward the right side of the right image.
No labels or arrows within panel b.

caption_claims.value: Caption lists results of FA as panel b.

evidence.quote: FA showed little dye leakage from the retinal vessels OS (Fig. 2b)

panels.general_description: Two OCT scans with a white arrow marked 2 on the right scan.
panels.detailed_description: Panel c shows two horizontal OCT cross-sections at the initial visit. Both show layered retina with a foveal dip and a bright outer line. A white arrow labeled 2 points upward from below the bright outer line in the right scan. The left scan has no arrow.
pixel_observations: White arrow labeled 2 below the outer line in the right scan.
No printed eye labels in panel c.

caption_claims.value: Caption states the EZ is discontinuous and a nodule is present at the RPE line at arrow 2 in c.

evidence.quote: In the OCT image from the initial visit, the EZ is discontinuous, and a hyper-refractive nodule is present at the RPE line (arrow 2 in c)

clinical_significance.statement: The authors describe a discontinuous EZ and an RPE-line nodule at the initial visit.

evidence.quote: OCT revealed a disrupted EZ and a hyper-reflective nodule along the RPE line (Fig. 2c, arrow 2)

limitations: EZ and nodule are caption and text claims; not independently judged.
Which scan is which eye is not labeled in the panel.

panels.general_description: Two OCT scans taken at follow-up.
panels.detailed_description: Panel d shows two horizontal OCT cross-sections in the lower row. Both show layered retina with a bright outer line; the right scan shows a foveal dip. No arrows or text labels are printed in panel d.

evidence.quote: OCT results at 4 months after starting treatment (d)

pixel_observations: Two scans without arrows or labels.

caption_claims.value: Caption states OCT at 4 months after starting treatment shows the EZ regenerated and continuous.

evidence.quote: Four months later, the EZ was regenerated and is now continuous (d)

clinical_significance.statement: The authors report EZ regeneration at 4 months.

evidence.quote: After four months, his left BCVA improved to 0.9, and the EZ was regenerated and appeared continuous on the OCT (Fig. 2d)

limitations: Regeneration of the EZ is a caption and text claim; not independently judged from pixels.

panels.general_description: Two ERG plots with microvolt and millisecond axes and a black arrow.

Small rectangles outline the trough and peak regions and dotted reference lines are drawn. A black arrow points at the rising part of the trace in the right plot, just before the peak.
